headline: Cisco Email Threat Defense connector added; AWS CloudWatchLogs marked for deprecation
summary_md:
- **Cisco Email Threat Defense (ETD) Cortex XSOAR Connector** is a new pack that fetches ETD message events as incidents and ships a reclassification and remediation playbook.
- **AWS - CloudWatchLogs** carries a deprecation notice for November 2026, pointing users at the unified **AWS** integration.
- Deprecations landed on two Microsoft commands: the *display_name* argument of `azure-sentinel-threat-indicator-update`, and the *filter*, *select* and *expand* arguments of `azure-sc-list-alert`.
- **Microsoft Sentinel** also gained two incident fetch filters, and **Amazon Web Services** a *tags* argument on EKS access entry creation.

highlights.title: Cisco ETD email threats can be ingested and remediated from XSOAR
highlights.detail: The pack fetches malicious and suspicious ETD message events as incidents and includes a playbook that reclassifies verdicts and moves messages to quarantine, junk, inbox, trash or delete.

highlights.title: AWS - CloudWatchLogs will be deprecated in November 2026
highlights.detail: The release note recommends migrating to the unified AWS integration, which covers the same functionality plus broader AWS service support.

highlights.title: Microsoft Sentinel can exclude incidents by title and alert product
highlights.detail: New *Incident Titles to Not Fetch* and *Alert Product Names to Not Fetch* parameters filter fetched incidents.

highlights.title: Two Microsoft command arguments stopped working upstream
highlights.detail: Sentinel's API no longer supports updating indicator display names, and Defender for Cloud ignores the alert list filter arguments — use azure-rg-query instead.

items.Packs/ETDXsoarConnector: New pack: fetches Cisco Email Threat Defense message events as incidents, with an ETD Malicious Email incident type, an ETD Message ID field and a reclassification and remediation playbook.
items.Packs/AWS-CloudWatchLogs: Deprecation notice: the integration will be deprecated in November 2026 in favour of the unified AWS integration.
items.Packs/AzureSentinel: Added Incident Titles to Not Fetch and Alert Product Names to Not Fetch parameters, and deprecated and hid the display_name argument of azure-sentinel-threat-indicator-update.
items.Packs/AzureSecurityCenter: Deprecated the filter, select and expand arguments of azure-sc-list-alert, which Defender for Cloud no longer supports; use azure-rg-query to filter alerts.
items.Packs/AWS: Added a tags argument to the aws-eks-access-entry-create command.
items.Packs/GoogleDrive: Binary output from the Google Drive get-file-content command is now tagged ;base64, alongside the shared GoogleDriveApiModule and the Google Drive standard connector.
